name: Service with a Smile
description: Service with a Smile was a LAAT/i gunship used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic. The nose art featured a bomb with Kit Fisto's face on it, and written in Aurebesh underneath was the name of the ship. It was used during a assault on Mon Calamari.

data.name: Service with a Smile
armament: Anti-personnel laser turrets (2 at the front)
passengers: Several clone troopers and a Jedi Master
